_readme: Single source of truth for every tunable setting in the daily feed.
Read at run time by hermes/brief.md, scripts/validate.mjs,
Change a number here and everything follows — nothing is duplicated in code.
Anything NOT listed here is a hard part of the contract; see schema.md.

locale._note: outputLanguage is keyed by section, with `default` covering every section not named. Local and national are written in Spanish because that is the language of their sources and of the city Shane lives in — translating a Lugo council story into English only puts a layer of paraphrase between him and what was actually said. Source language is never restricted anywhere; see brief.md.
locale.localArea: Lugo, Galicia, Spain — the city and its province
locale.northernIrelandArea: Northern Ireland — all six counties, with the north-west (Strabane, Derry, Tyrone) of particular interest

sections._note: Adding or removing a section here is NOT a content-only change: the same list is an enum in NewsApp/Models/NewsCategory.swift, and the app decodes `category` strictly — a category the installed build doesn't know throws and takes the whole feed down with it, rather than dropping the one story. Ship the app change first.

writing._note: bodyWords counts prose only — subhead text is navigation, not story, and is excluded from the count. paragraphWords.min is guidance for the writer; only the max is checked, because a deliberately short paragraph is a legitimate choice and a runaway one never is.

research._note: Caps on searching, to stop a run going in circles. Unlike everything else in this file these are enforced by Hermes reading the brief, not by a script — nothing checks afterwards whether they were respected.

photos._note: A card photo fills roughly 1206x1311 physical pixels on the phone. maxLongEdge below that guarantees upscaling; sources below the minimums cannot look good at that size. minSource* is a direct trade against bare gradient cards: lower catches more Open Graph/Twitter-card-sized sources (commonly 640x360 or 600x315) at the cost of more upscaling softness on the smallest ones let through.

sources._note: Starting points, not a closed list. Follow the story wherever it leads, but these are the outlets Shane expects each section to draw on.
